summary.text: Randy Robertson represents Senate District 29 in the Georgia Senate and was first sworn in on January 14, 2019.

paragraphs.text: He served 30 years with the Muscogee County Sheriff's Office, retiring in 2015 as a Bureau Commander at the rank of Major.
He also served as Director of Homeland Security for the city of Columbus and is a past president of the Georgia Fraternal Order of Police.
